title: Agent-led install and project adoption
location: Public install entry → setup agent mode → yoke-global → installed yoke skill
note: Existing and mature projects need intake and preservation, not a forced blank-slate scaffold. Full project onboarding remains a project operation. Discovery selects yoke, not a separate Onboard entry; terminal handoffs name both supported invocation forms.
current: https://upyoke.com/ ships the agent entry; full install proof is pending. Without a terminal, setup and the installer run agent mode (yoke setup --agent): one resumable JSON question at a time, browser steps as data. Machine approval and GitHub sign-in end the call: the private setup file keeps the pending authorization and the next call checks it once, so no call waits on a person and stopping one loses no approval. The agent approves machine and GitHub codes; only password entry goes to a person. Steps that change the machine (the Project step's clone, a saved connection, a backup restore, an opened git installer, what Apply created) record run facts in that setup file, and replayed screens read them first, so each call lands on the question the previous call printed; the wizard's Back and Forward use the same facts. The installed yoke skill ($yoke onboard in Codex; /yoke onboard in Claude Code or Cursor) checks the session (yoke doctor run --session), starts from existing work and configures only what the first work needs. Machine setup also writes Yoke's machine-wide hooks into each installed harness's user config, with or without a project, and lists one install-machine-hooks step per target file in the review. Admission separates own machines, teammates and explicit tokens; progress carries match_code, approval_hint, browser link and wait. Secret invites require TUI input.
desired: Same setup engine with structured resumable answers; relevant GitHub explanation; readiness then project-bound minimal onboard.
